candidates.explanation: When the update DTO has no `photo` field (undefined, as in a first-name-only edit), the code sets `photo = null`. The mapper turns null into an explicit null FK, so the stored photo is cleared. The condition should be `=== null`, as in `create`. When `photo` is undefined, it should stay undefined so the persistence layer leaves the column untouched.

fix.description: Change the branch to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`. This clears the photo only when the client explicitly sends null. An omitted photo stays undefined and is left unchanged.

candidates.explanation: When the update DTO has no `photo` field (undefined, as in a first-name-only edit), the code sets `photo = null`. The mapper turns null into an explicit null FK, so the stored photo is cleared. The condition should be `=== null`, as in `create`. When `photo` is undefined, it should stay undefined so the persistence layer leaves the column untouched.

fix.description: Change the branch to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`. This clears the photo only when the client explicitly sends null. An omitted photo stays undefined and is left unchanged.
